remarks: This meticulously maintained two-bedroom, two-bathroom condo boasts 9'+ ceilings, expansive windows that flood the space with natural light, and an open-concept layout designed for both comfortable living and effortless entertaining. Upon entering, you're welcomed by a chef-worthy kitchen featuring GE Profile stainless steel appliances, including a gas range, sleek granite countertops, an oversized eat-in island, and ample cabinetry. The kitchen seamlessly flows into the dining area and spacious living room, creating an inviting atmosphere. Off the living room, step onto the private balcony, enhanced with a custom-built hedge wall and bistro lighting, providing the perfect spot to unwind. The primary suite features a full en-suite bathroom, custom blackout shades, and a spacious California walk-in closet with valet rods, belt racks, built-in hampers, and additional tailored storage. The second bedroom, complete with new carpeting, a generous closet, and direct balcony access, is perfect for guests or a home office. Additional conveniences include in-unit laundry with a brand-new GE washer and dryer (2024) and extra storage space, a new refrigerator (2022), and a recently installed hot water heater (2024) with an automatic shut-off feature.
